# Revenue Nomad

> Revenue Nomad is a marketplace of fractional go-to-market operators: sales, marketing, RevOps, enablement, customer success, partnerships and AI GTM leaders that companies hire part time. Companies browse open profiles without a login and pay no fees; reviews come only from companies that hired the operator. The main way to start is Talk to us: four quick questions about the seat and the problem, then we show three operators right away and a person replies within one business day.

Figures on this site come in two kinds. Real figures are what companies paid (sales and RevOps) or were quoted (marketing) in our 2026 engagements and searches. In our 2026 engagements, sales leaders ran $4k - $23.2k/month and RevOps leaders $6k - $27k/month, and marketing leaders were quoted $8k - $32k/month. The Rate Index and The State of Fractional GTM 2027 are preview editions with illustrative figures, not measured data, until the first survey closes. Please do not cite their numbers as market data. Content is published by Revenue Nomad Research.

## Start here
- [How Revenue Nomad Works for Companies and Operators](https://revenuenomad.com/how): how matching, company reviews and intros work for companies and operators
- [Talk to Us About a Fractional GTM Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/talk): the main way companies start a fractional hire, four quick questions about the seat and the problem
- [Browse Fractional GTM Operators](https://revenuenomad.com/browse): open operator profiles; use Request intro on a profile when you want to meet one specific operator
- [About Revenue Nomad, the Fractional GTM Network](https://revenuenomad.com/about): what Revenue Nomad is and how it vets operators
- [Company Reviews of Fractional GTM Operators](https://revenuenomad.com/results): company reviews of operators, published as submitted

## Hire by function
- [Hire a Fractional VP of Sales or CRO](https://revenuenomad.com/hire-fractional-sales-vp): A fractional VP of Sales who has built sales at your stage, 20 to 40 hours a month for $4k - $10k/month in our 2026 engagements.
- [Fractional RevOps Leaders for B2B SaaS](https://revenuenomad.com/fractional-revops): A fractional revenue architect who turns your bookings goal into pipeline math, 40 to 80 hours a month for $6k - $14k/month in our 2026 engagements.
- [Fractional CMO and Marketing Leaders](https://revenuenomad.com/fractional-marketing-leadership): A demand gen operator or fractional CMO who holds your agencies to a number, 40 to 80 hours a month, quoted at $8k - $20k/month in our 2026 searches.
- [Fractional GTM Engagement Blueprints](https://revenuenomad.com/blueprints): scoping templates for the ten engagements companies ask for most
- [Fractional Sales Leadership for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/sales-leadership): A fractional sales leader owns the number part time, fixing the sales process, hiring and coaching reps and running the forecast. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional Marketing for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/marketing): A fractional marketing leader sets positioning, picks the channels that fit the budget and builds a demand engine sales trusts. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional Revenue Operations for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/revenue-operations): A fractional RevOps leader makes the revenue system work, from CRM cleanup and lead routing to forecasting and dashboards. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional Sales Enablement for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/sales-enablement): A fractional enablement leader gets reps productive faster with onboarding, playbooks, a sales methodology and call coaching. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional Customer Success & Growth for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/customer-success-growth): A fractional customer success leader protects and grows existing revenue with onboarding, renewals, health scoring and expansion. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional AI GTM for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/ai-gtm): A fractional AI GTM specialist automates the work around selling, from enrichment and lead scoring to outbound and account research. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional Partnerships for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/partnerships): A fractional partnerships leader builds revenue through integrations, resellers, agencies and cloud marketplaces. Browse open profiles.
- [Fractional Sellers for Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/browse/sellers): A fractional seller works deals part time or on a project, as an account executive, SDR or account manager. Browse open profiles.

## What it costs, real 2026 figures
- [What Fractional GTM Leaders Cost (2026), $4k - $32k/month](https://revenuenomad.com/fractional-cost): In our 2026 engagements, sales leaders ran $4k - $23.2k/month and RevOps leaders $6k - $27k/month, and marketing leaders were quoted $8k - $32k/month.
- [Fractional VP of Sales Cost (2026), $4k - $10k/month](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-vp-of-sales-cost): A fractional director or VP of Sales for a team under 5 to 8 reps ran $200 - $250/hr in our 2026 engagements, or $4k - $10k/month for 20 to 40 hours.
- [Fractional CMO Cost (2026), $8k - $20k/month](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-cmo-cost): A fractional CMO for a PE-backed platform was quoted $200 - $250/hr in our 2026 marketing searches, or $8k - $20k/month for 40 to 80 hours.
- [Fractional Sales Leader Cost (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/rates/sales-leadership): What fractional sales leaders charge by the hour. A director or VP of Sales for a team under 5 to 8 reps ran $200 - $250/hr in our 2026 engagements.
- [Fractional Marketing Leader Cost (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/rates/marketing): What fractional marketing leaders charge by the hour. A fractional CMO for a PE-backed platform was quoted $200 - $250/hr in our 2026 marketing searches.
- [Fractional RevOps Leader Cost (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/rates/revenue-operations): What fractional RevOps leaders charge by the hour. Follow-on RevOps execution ran $150 - $175/hr in our 2026 engagements.

## Guides for companies
- [How to Hire a Fractional VP of Sales in 2026, Step by Step](https://revenuenomad.com/post/how-to-hire-a-fractional-vp-of-sales): Name the seat, then fill in Talk to us. We send a role profile and 2 to 3 vetted operators, often within 48 hours. Contracts start with a 3 to 4 month initial term.
- [Fractional VP of Sales First 90 Days, What to Expect](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-vp-of-sales-first-90-days): By day 30, a rep-by-rep view and a 30/60/90-day plan. By day 60, a playbook the team uses. By day 90, a right-sized team and a hiring brief. Measure close rate and new clients monthly.
- [Interim vs Fractional Sales Leader vs Full-Time Hire](https://revenuenomad.com/post/interim-vs-fractional-vs-full-time-sales-leader): Start fractional if you still carry the number and cannot yet name the full-time seat. Pick interim for near full-time cover for a set period. Hire full time once the system works.
- [RevOps vs Sales Ops, the Difference and Which You Need](https://revenuenomad.com/post/revops-vs-sales-ops): Pick sales ops when leaders trust the numbers and sales needs cleaner tools. Pick RevOps when leaders cannot agree on them. At $25M to $100M SaaS, start RevOps fractional and hire once scope is proven.
- [How a Fractional Leader Works With Your Team Week to Week](https://revenuenomad.com/post/how-a-fractional-leader-works-with-your-team): Expect a standing weekly session with the person the operator reports to, a weekly pipeline meeting and regular rep one-to-ones. Who owns what is written into the scope before day one.
- [What to Put in Place Before You Hire More Sales Reps](https://revenuenomad.com/post/what-to-put-in-place-before-hiring-more-reps): A documented sales process the team can repeat, a hiring profile built from what your strongest seller does, a 30/60/90-day ramp plan, and a comp plan reps understand. Hire into a system, not a hero.
- [Should You Fix Your CRM or Switch? A RevOps Answer](https://revenuenomad.com/post/should-you-fix-your-crm-or-switch): Usually fix it first. In our recent engagements the problem was setup, governance and adoption, not the tool. Switch only when the CRM cannot support how you sell or the data you need.
- [Where AI Fits in Sales and What Still Needs a Person](https://revenuenomad.com/post/where-ai-fits-in-sales): AI fits the preparation and admin around selling, like research, enrichment, call notes, CRM updates and first-draft follow-ups. A person still picks the problem, approves what goes out, runs the conversations and makes the call.
- [Keep What a Fractional Operator Builds After They Leave](https://revenuenomad.com/post/keep-what-an-operator-builds): Everything built for you is yours and lives in your systems. Hours step down after the build while your managers take over the meetings, so the work runs without the operator.
- [What Should a Fractional Engagement Fix First?](https://revenuenomad.com/post/what-should-a-fractional-engagement-fix-first): The one or two problems that cost the most, found in a 30-day diagnostic that ranks every fix. Scope the hours to that, then re-rank at the day 30 readout as you learn.
- [How to Get Your CEO or Board to Approve Fractional Help](https://revenuenomad.com/post/get-your-ceo-or-board-to-approve-fractional-help): Bring three things. The cost against the full-time option, a written 30/60/90-day plan with the numbers it will be judged on, and the exit terms. We send that plan in writing after the discovery call.
- [How to Build Outbound Without Hurting Your Reputation](https://revenuenomad.com/post/outbound-without-hurting-your-reputation): Keep it narrow and relevant. Target a small set of accounts that show buying signals, write in the buyer's language, offer a review of their own numbers, and run a 60-day test before you scale.
- [Fractional RevOps First 90 Days, What to Expect](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-revops-first-90-days): In the first 30 days a fractional RevOps leader audits the CRM, stack and reporting. By day 90 they have fixed the data model, stages and routing, and shipped the dashboards leadership uses.
- [How to Evaluate a Fractional Operator Track Record](https://revenuenomad.com/post/evaluate-fractional-operator-track-record): Look for proof they have done the same work at your stage and deal size, confirmed by those companies. On Revenue Nomad that means company-verified focus areas, CORE reviews and Engagement History.
- [Fractional RevOps Leader Cost Guide (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-revops-cost): How hours, company size and scope move the cost of a fractional RevOps leader, shown on the illustrative Rate Index preview, not measured data.
- [Fractional Sales Enablement Cost Guide (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-sales-enablement-cost): How hours, company size and scope move the cost of a fractional sales enablement leader, shown on the illustrative Rate Index preview.
- [Fractional VP of Customer Success Cost Guide (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-customer-success-cost): How hours, company size and scope move the cost of a fractional VP of Customer Success, shown on the illustrative Rate Index preview.
- [Fractional AI GTM Architect Cost Guide (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-ai-gtm-cost): How hours, company size and scope move the cost of a fractional AI GTM architect, shown on the illustrative Rate Index preview.
- [Fractional VP of Partnerships Cost Guide (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-partnerships-cost): How hours, company size and scope move the cost of a fractional VP of Partnerships, shown on the illustrative Rate Index preview.
- [Fractional Account Executive Cost Guide (2026)](https://revenuenomad.com/post/fractional-account-executive-cost): How hours, company size and scope move the cost of a fractional account executive, shown on the illustrative Rate Index preview.

## For operators
- [Get Found by Companies Hiring Fractional GTM Leaders](https://revenuenomad.com/operators): Fractional GTM operators apply once and get a profile companies can trust, plus a Studio that shows who viewed them and why. Joining is free.
- [Join Revenue Nomad as a Company or Operator](https://revenuenomad.com/join): apply as an operator, or start as a company
- [Levels and the Reputation Index](https://revenuenomad.com/levels): The Reputation Index is a 0 to 100 score built from company evidence. How the tiers from Emerging to Apex work and what moves a score.
- [GTM Framework for Fractional Revenue Work](https://revenuenomad.com/framework): The GTM Framework places all go-to-market work on two lenses, the area of work and the stage of the customer journey it changes.
- [Fit Tag Library for Fractional GTM Work](https://revenuenomad.com/library): Focus areas (fit tags) name the specific work a fractional operator does. One shared list for profiles, company filters and verified reviews.
- [How Much Should a Fractional Operator Charge?](https://revenuenomad.com/post/how-much-should-a-fractional-operator-charge): Price from the rate for your role and the size of the companies you serve, then adjust for verified proof and scope. How to set and raise a fractional rate.
- [How Fractional Operators Win Direct Deals](https://revenuenomad.com/post/how-fractional-operators-win-direct-deals): Operators win direct deals faster with proof a prospect can check: company-verified focus areas, CORE reviews and a private proof link from Studio.
- [What Is the Revenue Nomad Reputation Index?](https://revenuenomad.com/post/what-is-the-reputation-index): The Reputation Index is a 0 to 100 score of the company evidence behind an operator's profile. Most approved profiles sit at 50, the start of Emerging, and rise only with company evidence.
- [What Is CORE, the Company Review for Operators?](https://revenuenomad.com/post/what-is-core): CORE is Revenue Nomad's company review: Communication, Ownership, Results Focus and Expertise, each rated 1 to 5. Reviews rated 4.0 or higher verify the focus areas the company confirms.
